slice: SOCIAL-01 YouTube OAuth provider contract, local only
checks: Fixed Google OAuth token/revocation and YouTube channel endpoints, no caller-controlled URL.
Production HTTPS exact callback and local-only HTTP validation; 32-byte random state and S256 PKCE proof.
Offline consent for YouTube read-only identity and upload scopes; granted-scope and refresh-token checks.
Channel lookup rejects zero/multiple channels; refresh preserves rotated refresh token response and rejects scope downgrade.
Revocation sends refresh token in POST form body and requires a confirmed success response.
Provider errors are generic and do not expose tokens or codes in thrown messages.
limits: Pure provider protocol helper only; no start/callback route, one-time state store, session binding or connected account persisted yet.
No application token refresh/remote revoke transition or verified provider reconciliation wired.
No live Google call, developer credentials, UI, scheduler, provider send or test post.
Focused cases and API build only; prior 189/9/7/5 native CI belongs to published base, not this local source delta.
